_metadata.description: UPS model catalog for closet-class UPSs (typically <= 6 kVA single-phase). Each entry includes battery_type ('lithium_ion' or 'vrla') and modular (true/false). The recommendation engine favors lithium_ion entries — they have 2-3x the service life of VRLA, tolerate higher closet ambient temps, and have lower lifetime TCO despite higher upfront cost. runtime_curve is a %-load->minutes estimate; an optional runtime_curve_watts (watt->minutes points, manufacturer-verified) takes precedence when present on a row. Optional input_voltage_v/input_phase/max_input_current_a/recommended_breaker_a/input_plug surface manufacturer breaker/plug data in place of the NEC-80%-rule estimate — populate only where confirmed, absence falls back to the estimate. For >15 kVA building-level UPS sizing, see ups_modular_units.json.
_metadata.pricing_note: list_price_usd is a street price (CDW advertised or sign-in price from a cdw.com web snapshot, see price_source) unless price_source says otherwise; msrp_usd is the manufacturer list price CDW showed alongside it. Prices are planning figures, not quotes.
